purpose: Phase-7B angiogenic states + vessel architecture as SCHEMATIC abstractions. Represents vessel density / branching complexity / maturity / organization only - NOT individual endothelial cells, blood pressure, capillary ultrastructure, or blood rheology. Schematic 0-1 values; no absolute vessel count / diameter. Vessels MODIFY delivery/oxygen/nutrient only - they never signal, remodel, or induce apoptosis.
note: Tumour vasculature is typically abnormal (hypervascular but immature/chaotic); schematic ordinal only.
